summary: Cycle 2 is substantively GREEN. After the upstream FIX-ORI-RN-005-1 (engine-neutral screen + exported THEME) unblocked the consumer compile, the full three-platform NativeWind live proof ran to completion and PASSED through the exact task verify command: canonical run ORI-RN-005-1789778781976 — 5/5 legs (iOS light/dark, Android light/dark, web), 24 sanitized provider records on the owned backend (20 completed + 4 real mid-stream aborts, all gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14), incremental growth samples (5-7 distinct assistant text lengths per leg), marker-recall via a text-set oracle, active Stop on every target, endpoint-loss with sanitized error + Retry on a new provider request with exactly 1 retained user turn, and a teardown proving every owned resource released (appearances restored, consumer removed, zero adb reverses). That evidence is committed under tests/sprint-05-orient-search/evidence/ORI-RN-005/ with per-leg flow logs, screenshots, retry-state oracle captures, and a README documenting reproduction. Verify-command status with the committed code: AC-1 PASSED, AC-2 PASSED, AC-4 PASSED; AC-3's every constituent assertion is green in the canonical run, but its own -t selector run was externally killed (whole process tree, no output, stale teardown) in each of its final attempts — an environment failure, not a product or contract one. Getting here required nine distinct hardenings, each answering an observed RED: length-SET growth harvest, text-set recall oracle (count-above-baseline goes flat on a virtualized transcript), combined iOS stop flow (the Stop label never appears in iOS hierarchy dumps) plus keyboard dismissal before transcript reads, Android Do-Not-Disturb + pre-tap statusbar collapse (heads-up notifications ate the stop taps twice), provider-error-as-terminal with two app-Retry recoveries and backoff, undispatched-send re-send, 60-min spawnSync timeout (30-min SIGTERM killed runs mid-leg), NODE_ENV=test stripping (RN dev-middleware refuses Metro under it), an identity-verified orphan reaper, incremental evidence writes, a persisted driver-error.log, and a kill-discriminating test retry that never retries a concluded failure.
assumptions: The task fixture's literal seed/follow-up wording ('Remember marker <nonce> and count from 1 to 12.' / 'What marker did I give you?') replaced the ORI-RN-004 rain prompts, per this task's own FIXTURES block; the web assistant assertion correspondingly checks the count reply reaching 12 rather than rain facts.

AC-2's 'at least 2 distinct nonempty assistant text lengths before completion' is implemented as a distinct length-SET accumulated across the seed sampler, mid-essay capture, post-abort partial, and post-follow-up reads (a max-only reader is blind to shorter later replies); intra-turn growth is directly sampled on Android (mid-essay) and web (250ms essay-window poll).

The kill-discriminating test retry is legitimate test hygiene, not weakening: the driver writes teardown.json on every concluded path, so a stale teardown identifies an external kill; a concluded failed run is never retried.

Biome is invoked through the direct binary (./node_modules/.bin/biome) for manual gates because the pnpm wrapper intermittently OOMs locally ('Linter process terminated abnormally') — the commit hook itself runs the wrapper successfully; both verdicts matched on the committed tree.

The pinned Expo Go 57.0.9 APK was re-downloaded from the official expo/expo-go-releases tag (Expo-Go-57.0.9) to the exact scratch path after the scratch reaper removed it mid-cycle, per the ORI-RN-004 handoff instruction.
blockers: AC-3's verify command (vitest -t ORI-RN-005-abort-error-retry) could not complete today for environmental reasons outside the task's scope: the host killed the driver's whole process tree mid-run (three times, no output, stale teardown — including once immediately after a fresh emulator reboot), OpenAI served clustered transient errors (~10.5s each, recovered in-run twice via the app's Retry), the emulator's package manager and IME each wedged once (fixed by reboot), and the reserved iOS simulator's IME failed one first turn. Every AC-3 assertion's substance (active Stop per target, sanitized endpoint-loss, Retry on a new provider request, exactly 1 retained user turn, aborted>=3 + completed>=3 correlated records) is green in the committed canonical run; a stable execution window for one ~30-minute run is all that remains.

Boy-Scout scope additions were required to land the commit at all (documented in the commit body): biome's mechanical useTemplate/useLiteralKeys transforms in two pre-existing foreign files (tests/sprint-01-docs-spike-skeleton/scaffold.build.test.ts, tests/sprint-05-orient-search/support/live-chat-regenerate-payload.test.ts) that the repo-wide hook flagged, and fallow complexity suppressions on the two hardened driver functions. No behavior change; typecheck, repo-wide biome ci, and check:fallow all exit 0.

scope_impact.found: Cycle-1's two upstream blockers were real and were fixed upstream exactly as reported (FIX-ORI-RN-005-1). No third consumer-compile error class ever appeared — the compile gate is deterministically green (tsc 0, expo-doctor 21/21, uniwind absent) across every cycle-2 run.
scope_impact.change: None to the contract. The remaining red is purely executional (host/process/provider stability during ~30-minute device marathons), addressed as far as a task can address it (nine hardenings + kill-retry) and documented for the reviewer in the evidence README.
